data.name: Jasur
data.gender_notes: Jasur is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who assists Allah and His Messenger (peace be upon them). Derived from the root word 'asara' which means 'to help'. The name Jasur carries the meaning “God's helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jasur usually hope their child will grow to embody god's helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be a faithful servant of Allah, helping others and spreading goodness in the world.
data.etymology: Jasur belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jasur total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: جسور
